maker: Takenaka Corporation, Kajima Corporation and Aktio
model: Material auto-transport robot (資機材自動搬送ロボット)
name: Takenaka / Kajima / Aktio material auto-transport robot
summary: Low autonomous transport robot that unloads pallets, carts and board stacks of up to 2 t from the construction elevator and drives them to their place on the floor, using a map made from the building's BIM data. Developed jointly by the Japanese contractors Takenaka and Kajima with the rental firm Aktio and tested on a site in Osaka.

germany.statusNote: Development announced in December 2024 with trials on Japanese sites planned until April 2025; Aktio is to handle rental once it is commercialised. No sale or rental yet confirmed, and no route outside Japan.

specs.label: Loads carried
specs.quote: パレット、台車、ボード材

specs.label: Sensors
specs.value: 2D LiDAR and a barcode reader that finds 2D codes on the pallets
specs.quote: 本体上部に2D LiDARおよびバーコードリーダーを搭載している

specs.label: Navigation
specs.value: map generated from BIM data; stops at obstacles not on the map
specs.quote: 建物のBIMデータから作成した自動走行用地図をもとに、フロアの所定の位置まで自律移動できる

specs.label: Control system
specs.value: Takenaka construction robot platform (RPF) plus Kajima transport management app (JHS), linked to the construction elevator
specs.quote: 竹中工務店が開発した「建設ロボットプラットフォーム（RPF）」、鹿島建設が開発した「自動搬送管理システム（JHSアプリ）」

notes: Moves between floors in the construction elevator and unloads itself at the set floor.
Meant to run during breaks and at night when few people are on site (developers).

images.alt: Red low transport robot with pallet forks, its barcode reader and 2D lidar labelled

evidence.task: Carried materials automatically from the construction elevator to set places on the floor
evidence.note: Developers confirmed automatic transport worked on a real site in July 2024; more site trials planned until April 2025.

sources.title: 竹中工務店ら3社、資機材自動搬送ロボットを開発 (18 December 2024, with specifications)
竹中工務店・鹿島など開発、「資機材自動搬送ロボ」の機能

openQuestions: Has Aktio started renting the robot? Not confirmed in any page read.
